source_diagnosis.existing_observation: drainage_response_signed_exchange_native is set on each physical advance as rate * that advance duration
source_diagnosis.defect: After accepted two-half composition, last_observation describes the second half-step and is therefore not authoritative for the integrated accepted-window drainage transfer.
source_diagnosis.consequence: A coupling participant using last_observation.drainaige_response_signed_exchange_native can publish only the final half-step amount while committing a whole-window candidate.

repair_contract.approach: Add worker-local signed drainage-exchange accumulation to the serialized model attempt context.
repair_contract.rollback: Checkpoint/full/half/retry restore the accumulator with the same transaction attempt context as other worker-local carriers.
repair_contract.accepted_value: After the accepted half path, the accumulator equals half1 + half2 signed drainage exchange for the accepted coupling window.
repair_contract.compatibility: Keep existing per-physical-advance drainage_response_signed_exchange_native semantics unchanged; expose a separate window-integrated observation for F-APP09.
repair_contract.participant_rule: F-APP09 may publish/compare only the window-integrated exchange, never the last physical-step exchange.

anti_retuning_rule: No numerical or scientific tolerance is widened. Owner qualification must still prove mismatch discard/replay, matched commit, signed positive/negative transfer and stale-origin rejection.
